class InterpreterTests(CommandTestCase):
    NAMESPACES = [
        {"data": {"type": "list", "value": "[1, 2]"}, "x": {"type": "str"},
         "obj": {"type": "Foo", "attributes": ["alpha", "beta"]},
         "jn": {"type": "function", "module": "os.path", "name": "join"}},
        {"data": {"type": "dict"}, "zed": {"type": "int", "value": "5"}},
    ]

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.namespaces = self.write("ns.json", json.dumps(self.NAMESPACES))

    def interpret(self, command, source, line, col, key):
        path = self.write("main.py", source)
        return self.run_json(command, path, line, col, "--interpreter",
                             "--namespaces", self.namespaces, key=key)

    def test_completion_merges_namespaces(self):
        source = "x = 1\n\n"
        result = self.by_name(self.interpret("complete", source, 2, 0, "completions"))
        self.assertEqual(result["x"]["description"], "instance of int")  # static wins
        self.assertEqual(result["data"], {"name": "data", "complete": "data", "type": "list",
                                          "description": "list (runtime)"})
        self.assertEqual(result["zed"]["description"], "int (runtime)")

    def test_attribute_completion(self):
        names = self.names(self.interpret("complete", "data.app", 1, 8, "completions"))
        self.assertEqual(names, ["append"])
        names = self.names(self.interpret("complete", "obj.", 1, 4, "completions"))
        self.assertEqual(names, ["alpha", "beta"])

    def test_infer_and_goto_fallback(self):
        for command in ("infer", "goto"):
            [definition] = self.interpret(command, "data\n", 1, 0, "definitions")
            self.assertEqual((definition["name"], definition["type"], definition["description"]),
                             ("data", "list", "list (runtime)"))
        [static] = self.interpret("infer", "x = 1\nx\n", 2, 0, "definitions")
        self.assertEqual(static["name"], "int")
        self.assertEqual(self.interpret("infer", "missing\n", 1, 0, "definitions"), [])

    def test_signatures(self):
        [signature] = self.interpret("signatures", "jn(", 1, 3, "signatures")
        self.assertEqual(signature["name"], "join")

    def test_namespaces_require_interpreter(self):
        path = self.write("main.py", "data\n")
        result = self.run_sith(path, 1, 0, "--namespaces", self.namespaces, command="infer")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_json("infer", path, 1, 0, "--interpreter", key="definitions"), [])


class SettingsTests(CommandTestCase):
    def test_add_bracket_and_case(self):
        path = self.write("main.py", "def fun(): pass\nFu\n")
        result = self.by_name(self.run_json("complete", path, 2, 2, "--setting", "add_bracket=TRUE",
                                            key="completions"))
        self.assertEqual(result["fun"]["complete"], "n(")
        result = self.run_json("complete", path, 2, 2, "--setting", "case_insensitive=false",
                               key="completions")
        self.assertNotIn("fun", self.names(result))

    def test_invalid_settings(self):
        path = self.write("main.py", "x\n")
        for setting in ("bogus=true", "add_bracket=yes", "add_bracket"):
            self.assertEqual(self.run_sith(path, 1, 0, "--setting", setting).returncode, 1)

    def test_dynamic_params(self):
        path = self.write("main.py", "def f(a):\n    return a\nf(1)\n")
        self.assertEqual(len(self.run_json("infer", path, 2, 11, key="definitions")), 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_json("infer", path, 2, 11, "--setting", "dynamic_params=false",
                                       key="definitions"), [])


class ProjectTests(CommandTestCase):
    def init(self, *flags):
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SITH, "project", "init", self.dir, *flags],
                                capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        with open(os.path.join(self.dir, ".sith", "project.json"), encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            return json.load(handle)

    def test_init_and_merge(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.init(), {"environment_path": "", "sys_path": [],
                                       "added_sys_path": [], "smart_sys_path": True})
        self.assertEqual(self.init("--added-sys-path", "lib,src")["added_sys_path"], ["lib", "src"])
        config = self.init("--environment", "/usr/bin/python3")
        self.assertEqual((config["environment_path"], config["added_sys_path"]),
                         ("/usr/bin/python3", ["lib", "src"]))

    def test_sys_path_resolution(self):
        self.write("lib/helper.py", "def helper_fn():\n    pass\n")
        self.write("local.py", "def local_fn():\n    pass\n")
        path = self.write("main.py", "import helper\nimport local\nhelper.helper_fn\nlocal.local_fn\n")

        def resolved(line, col, *flags):
            return [d["module_path"] for d in self.run_json("goto", path, line, col, *flags,
                                                            key="definitions")]

        self.assertEqual(resolved(3, 8), [])
        self.assertEqual(resolved(4, 7), ["local.py"])
        self.init("--added-sys-path", "lib")
        self.assertEqual(resolved(3, 8), ["lib/helper.py"])
        self.assertEqual(resolved(4, 7, "--setting", "smart_sys_path=false"), [])
        self.assertEqual(resolved(3, 8, "--setting", "smart_sys_path=false"), ["lib/helper.py"])


class ContextTests(CommandTestCase):
    def test_context(self):
        source = "x = 1\nclass A:\n    def m(self):\n        pass\n"
        path = self.write("main.py", source)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_json("context", path, 1, 0), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.run_json("context", path, 4, 8), [
            {"name": "A", "type": "class", "line": 2, "column": 6},
            {"name": "m", "type": "function", "line": 3, "column": 8},
        ])


class EnvironmentTests(CommandTestCase):
    def env(self, *args, key="environments"):
        return self.run_json("env", *args, key=key)

    def test_info(self):
        info = self.env("info", sys.executable, key="executable")
        self.assertEqual(os.path.realpath(info), os.path.realpath(sys.executable))
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SITH, "env", "info", "/no/such/python"],
                                capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)

    def test_list_sorted_and_unique(self):
        environments = self.env("list")
        resolved = [os.path.realpath(e["executable"]) for e in environments]
        self.assertEqual(len(resolved), len(set(resolved)))
        self.assertIn(os.path.realpath(sys.executable), resolved)

    def test_find_virtualenvs(self):
        for name in ("one", "two"):
            subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "venv", "--without-pip",
                            os.path.join(self.dir, "envs", name)], check=True)
        found = self.env("find-virtualenvs", "--path", os.path.join(self.dir, "envs"))
        executables = [e["executable"] for e in found if e["executable"].startswith(self.dir)]
        self.assertEqual(len(executables), 2)
        self.assertTrue(all(e["is_virtualenv"] for e in found))
